books.title: Who Authorised This?
books.subtitle: When Machines Can Decide, Act, and Spend
books.question: Who holds authority when software can commit capital and act on its own?
books.summary: A book about authority, accountability and control in organisations where AI systems no longer just advise, but decide, act and spend.

books.title: Manufactured Value
books.question: Why does AI create less value than promised in investment firms?
books.summary: The industry is right that AI matters, but applies it at the wrong level of the organisation. The bottleneck is not access to intelligence; it is the operating system around it.

books.title: Everyone Sells the Same AI
books.subtitle: How Capital Markets and Private Equity Tell the Difference
books.status: Print and Kindle files final; proofs next
books.question: How should capital markets and private equity firms choose AI tools?
books.summary: Every AI vendor can demonstrate what looks like the same result, but they are not selling the same thing. A practical guide for capital markets and private equity leaders deciding what to buy, build or leave alone, ending each choice in one of six verdicts: BUY, BUILD, REUSE, COMBINE, DEFER or REJECT. Appendix H works one eligibility test through in full across eight named providers, using only their published documents. Appendix H sources and updates: writandledgerbooks.netlify.app/appendix-h

books.title: Against the Better Answer
books.question: What happens when organisations resist the better answer a machine gives them?
books.summary: On the institutional reasons good answers are ignored, and what leaders can do about it.

books.title: The Agreement Gap
books.question: Where do human agreements and machine actions fall out of step?
books.summary: On the space between what parties agree and what automated systems actually do.

books.title: When Capital Acts
books.question: What changes when capital allocation itself becomes automated?
books.summary: On investment decisions made and carried out by software, and the governance they need.

books.title: The AI Choice
books.subtitle: Volume 1
books.question: What does every professional need to understand about AI to choose well?
books.summary: The first volume of a two-part AI-literacy series for readers who must make decisions about AI.
